title: noDoubleBuyReconcile describe block given a 30 s per-test timeout
severity_rationale: The first test pays for a cold import of src/bot under load; no assertion changed.

evidence.note: describe() gained the option { timeout: 30_000 } and a two-line comment. No assertion, title, import or mock changed. Reason: Found by the 22-15 final run (vpu-20261109T045056-10640-6a8b4a). The first test in the file pays for the first dynamic import of src/bot, which took 4648 ms in the earlier full run and 5015 ms in this one against the unit default limit of 5000 ms (the file's other tests take 50-100 ms), so it timed out with no assertion failing. The new backupState test adds a 48 s compile to the parallel load and tipped it over.

sibling_sites_checked: Every entry of rails-test-edits.json is registered individually or merged with its discovery. The diff of test/unit/bot/noDoubleBuyReconcile.test.ts was re-read against audit_base_sha.
